# Streams oracle diff report (step 9)

Streams runs the unified matching layer (one ranker to the best identity
family, one selection rule — streams attaches the whole family — one cut at
`[matching]` sensitivity, here 95); Stream-Mapparr is the oracle.
Every difference below traces to a `data/corpus/decisions.json` row, a
documented fix or the unified selection rule; the unattributed list is the
review surface.

Section 2 is REPRESENTATIVE (seeded, not mined, with a known answer: read its
agreement rate as the migration's real-world size, and its right/wrong table
as which side is correct), run with the country filter off and on. Section 3
is mined from the pairs Stream-Mapparr takes but another plugin or the label
disputes, so its agreement rate is low by construction and it exists to show
every kind of difference, not how often they happen. Every section counts the
DIRECTION of each difference: streams only the unified engine writes (extra)
and streams only Stream-Mapparr writes (fewer). An extra stream the known
answer says is wrong is unattributed by rule: a write the evidence does not
back.
